column1: Few recordings re-sent to the Deepgram API with different settings. Same audio, same scoring. Table 1: DER %. Table 2 (below): words returned.

Not shown because they changed nothing: smart_format, punctuate, filler_words, paragraphs, numerals, diarize_model latest vs v2, utt_split from 0.1 to 2 s, word vs utterance timelines. Each stayed within about 2 points of the benchmark setting on 7 of the 8 recordings, and within 4 points on the eighth.
